summary: Tested refactored modular routers (loans, subscriptions, roles) and LoansPage UI. Backend: 20/20 tests passed (100%). Frontend: All UI elements verified working - KPIs, table, filters, create loan modal.
critical_code_review_comments: Router initialization pattern using init_router() with database and auth dependency injection works correctly
Loans API correctly calculates monthly payments for both interest and no-interest loans
Loans summary endpoint returns proper KPI data (total_active_loans, total_loaned, total_paid, total_pending)
Roles API correctly restricts custom roles to Enterprise plan only
Subscription API correctly handles trial, active, and cancellation flows
LoansPage UI has all required elements: KPI cards, filter dropdown, loans table, create modal
Sidebar correctly shows Préstamos link with feature access control based on subscription plan

test_credentials.note: User is on trial plan - upgraded temporarily to basic for UI testing

seed_data_creation: Created test loan for TEST_Loan Employee ($5,000, 6 months, no interest)
context_for_next_testing_agent: Modular routers fully tested. Key findings: 1) GET /api/loans returns list of loans with employee info enrichment, 2) GET /api/loans/summary returns KPI data, 3) POST /api/loans creates loan with payment schedule calculation, 4) GET /api/loans/{id} returns loan detail with payment schedule, 5) GET /api/subscription returns subscription with plan details and feature access, 6) GET /api/roles returns custom roles (Enterprise only) or message for non-Enterprise, 7) LoansPage UI shows KPIs, filter, table, and create modal with all form fields, 8) Sidebar shows Préstamos link with lock icon for trial users (feature access control working)
